title: Assistant Product Designer
note: Drafts custom versions of high-end lighting and furniture; asks for 1–3 years of ID experience.

facts.summary: Assistant designer supporting the custom-order pipeline at a lighting and furniture studio.
facts.duties: Produce technical drawing packages, installation instructions and templates for custom orders; organize files; coordinate with sales and assembly.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's in industrial design, SolidWorks and Adobe, 1–3 years ID experience, materials knowledge; US work authorization without sponsorship.
